With e v = (∂CΨ)(a, e Y ), there are row vectors e hijk + , e hijk − over R[[z]] such that, for every ordered triple of labels, Ψ(a, e Y ) = 0, ai,1aj,1ak,1 = e hijk + e v, pi(e Y − i )pj(e Y − j )pk(e Y − k ) = e hijk − e v.
